name: Full Event Calendar
summary: Full-featured event calendar CodeComponent powered by FullCalendar with dayGridPlugin, timeGridPlugin, interactionPlugin, and listPlugin. Features Month, Week, Day, and List views via ButtonGroup, click-to-create events with Dialog (title Input, time Select, category Select), click event for detail Dialog with edit/delete options, drag-to-resize events, Badge for event categories (Meeting=blue, Deadline=red, Social=green, Personal=purple), useAppState for current view and selected date range, and toast on create/update/delete. Starts with 15 demo events across the current month.
shortSummary: Full event calendar with FullCalendar, multi-view, drag-resize, create/delete dialogs, and category badges
